info.name: Phantom AI 2.0 - Complete API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for all Phantom AI 2.0 IDE & Dev OS endpoints including AI Agent, Workspace Tools, Compiler, Terminal Sessions, Git, Debugger, Chat, Projects, Auth, and System Intelligence.
